def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    fit = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    
    orig_capacity = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    load_ratio = (orig_capacity - rem[fit]) / orig_capacity
    
    # Power-law scoring for non-empty bins favoring high utilization
    scores[fit] = np.power(load_ratio, 3.0)
    
    # Handle empty bins differently to avoid premature new bin opening
    empty_mask = (bins == orig_capacity) & fit
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        # Give empty bins a base score that is modulated by the average load of currently used bins
        used_loads = orig_capacity - bins[bins < orig_capacity]
        avg_load = np.mean(used_loads) / orig_capacity if len(used_loads) > 0 else 0.0
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] = 0.1 + 0.5 * avg_load
        
    return scores

    if not np.any(fit):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 else 1.0
